name: Cyclic Behavior Type (CBT) Tool
description: The Cyclic Behavior Type (CBT) Tool is open-source software that estimates whether a fine-grained soil responds to cyclic loading more like a sand or more like a clay, from the record of a cyclic direct simple shear (CDSS) test. For every loading cycle it computes test metrics that describe the stress-strain loops, the excess pore pressure and the strain accumulation: the maximum excess pore pressure ratio, the ratio of the loop area to the area of its convex hull, the cyclic strain increment ratio, and the strain accumulation curvature. From these it estimates the cyclic behavior type (CBT), from 0 (clay-like) to 1 (sand-like), with ten Bayesian regression models that reproduce the judgments of ten analysts who classified 195 CDSS tests from the Next Generation Liquefaction (NGL) database. The analyst models are combined with equal weights in logit space, and the result is reported with its within- and between-analyst uncertainty. The tool is a static website: the Python code runs in the web browser with Pyodide, so uploaded test files never leave the user's computer. Tests can be uploaded as CSV files in any time and stress units, or loaded directly from the NGL database through its REST API. Per-cycle results and batch summaries are downloaded as CSV files.
